entries.name: Swin2SR x4 (real-world)
entries.notes: 12.05 M params; 6.2 s per 256² tile on MPS (measured, M3 16 GB). Windows ONNX artifact remains unapproved (W5-4 BLOCKED).

code.note: Apache-2.0 LICENSE, SwinIR Authors 2021 (dossier Appendix A A27).

conditions.text: The identity of the rights holder behind the weights is documented with its evidence URL and read date: the Hugging Face uploader `caidas` is a verified organisation whose overview states "Computer Vision Lab, CAIDAS, University of Würzburg", the lab that authored Swin2SR, so the checkpoint repo is the rights holder's own publication and not a mirror (https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/caidas/overview, read 2026-11-22).

The Apache grant itself is documented with its evidence URL and read date: the upstream project states "This project is released under the Apache 2.0 license." and ships an Apache-2.0 LICENSE (https://github.com/mv-lab/swin2sr, read 2026-11-22), which the same lab's verified Hugging Face repository repeats as `license:apache-2.0` for this checkpoint.

The training-data provenance is recorded in the register and the dossier rather than ignored: the same README states "We use mainly the DIV2K Dataset and Flickr2K datasets for training", and DIV2K is distributed for academic research purposes only; this product is a free, non-commercial application, so the research-only dataset note does not refuse the recorded use class, and the per-checkpoint mix beyond DIV2K/Flickr2K stays NOT VERIFIED.
The artefact remains download-only at release — no bytes are mirrored or bundled — and the Apache-2.0 notice below is preserved wherever the checkpoint is redistributed.

weights.notice: Apache-2.0. Redistributing or mirroring pytorch_model.bin requires a copy of the Apache-2.0 licence, the retained copyright notices, a statement of changes, and any NOTICE text; the upstream code licence carries “Copyright [2021] [SwinIR Authors]”.
weights.note: Approved with conditions on 2026-11-22 by the release manager, under the owner's standing execution authority rather than as an owner ruling, on rights-holder evidence read that day and re-read 2026-11-23 (see the four conditions and Docs/MODEL_LICENCES.md §11). This supersedes the record this branch first wrote, which held the only weights statement to be the repository-level `license:apache-2.0` tag and therefore inferred. The tag is not an inference about a third-party upload: the uploading organisation is the verified account of the paper's own lab, which states the Apache 2.0 release in its project README. What remains open is the training-data mix beyond DIV2K/Flickr2K, which is NOT VERIFIED and is recorded on the trainingData record rather than resolved here.

trainingData.note: Swin2SR's own training set is not confirmed; DIV2K, the usual corpus in this family, is made available for academic research purposes only, which is a residual dataset risk and not a term of the recorded weight grant (dossier §1, §2.1). The 2026-11-22 addendum records what the upstream project does state — "We use mainly the DIV2K Dataset and Flickr2K datasets for training" (https://github.com/mv-lab/swin2sr, read 2026-11-22) — which names the corpora but does not verify the per-checkpoint mix, so this record stays unknown.

entries.name: MI-GAN (512, Places2)
entries.notes: Weights are MIT (LICENSE-WEIGHTS); the ONNX pipeline is the author's own export. Spot healing only, and only on macOS: the worker refuses holes above 25 % of the frame and routes object removal to flux2-klein-4b-q4. No Windows runtime executes a submitted job (W5-3), so the entry is not advertised on windows-x64.
